description: The legal acts one issue or one wiki page refers to — in its own text and in the comments on it. Each reference: its 'id' (pass it to remove_legal_reference), where it stands ('in': issue, comment, page or wikiComment, with 'commentId'), the act ('document': id, url, sourceUrl, title, hasText, asOf — the day its text is as of), the 'place' cited («Article 18»), the 'quote' it was read from, 'foundBy' (url, pattern, model or hand) and 'state' — 'proposed' is the model's offer that nobody accepted yet, 'rejected' one somebody said no to. 'editionChangedAt' is set when the act's text was found changed since the reference was made and nobody has looked at it since ('editionReaches': whether the change is in the place cited, null when that cannot be told) — a person marks it looked at on the screen. 'enabled' false means the project does not keep legal references, and the list is empty. Needs only permission to see the issue or the page. In JQL and CQL the same is the field legalRef.

issue.description: Issue key, e.g. 'UK-1'. Either this or 'page'.

page.description: Wiki page id (as returned by search_wiki). Either this or 'issue'.

name: list_legal_references
